item.title: Money-moving ops take idempotency_key, checked first
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.

Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.
